ai.notice.chat: This chat uses AI and can make mistakes. You confirm the slot; service rules and health staff manage the appointment.
ai.notice.interview: This interview uses AI. Your clinician reads your answers during the visit; it does not replace care or provide medical advice.
ai.notice.order: AI reads your referral. The complete image is sent to the provider; staff review the request.
ai.notice.lab: These results are read using AI. Discuss them with your clinician. Uploaded images are sent in full to the provider.
ai.notice.clinical: AI-generated content. Review sources before confirming or using it in care.
ai.notice.mcp: The connected assistant uses AI and receives your identity and authorized tool data. Review its proposals before acting.
ai.notice.dni: AI reads the complete ID photo through an external provider. Review the data before registering.
ai.notice.translation: AI proposes translations. Review before publishing.
ai.notice.prompt: AI translates edited instructions. Review the changes before use.
ai.notice.knowledge: AI proposes article properties. Review before saving.
ai.notice.probe: Test sends a technical message to AI without patient data.
ai.notice.case: This conversation uses AI. It gives no medical advice: hospital staff read your case and decide the appointment.
ai.register.title: AI register
ai.register.invalid_notification: Could not record notification. Check the reference and date.
ai.profile.save: Save this reviewed profile on confirmation
ai.cancel.confirm: Open the appointment and confirm cancellation.
ai.booking.confirm: Choose and confirm the appointment on the service page.
ai.function.mcp_assistant: Tools for a connected external MCP assistant
ai.notice.voice: Voice dictation uses AI. Your complete audio is sent to the provider and may include identifying details.
ai.voice.disabled: Voice dictation is disabled. You can type your message.
ai.function.voice_transcription: Voice dictation for chat and interview
ai.function.case_chat: Questions about a case with no free slots and a summary for the desk
ai.profile.unsaved: You have unsaved profile edits. Select Save this reviewed profile before confirming.
ai.profile.replace: Replace your profile edits with the AI proposal?
ai.data.document_identity_signature: identity and signature in the document
ai.data.document_identity_health: identity and health data in the document
ai.data.account_identity: account identity and dependants, through an authorized token
ai.data.name: name
ai.data.technical_message: technical message with no personal data
ai.data.spoken_identity: symptoms or identity details that are spoken
ai.kill.fake_ai: TURNOS_FAKE_AI=1 (normal flows; a controlled fictitious seed may be exempt)
ai.kill.intake_enabled: INTAKE_ENABLED (inherited value, OFF by default; explicit per-doctor overrides win)
ai.pii.exception: Text pseudonymized and restored with core/pii.py where applicable. Deliberate exception: the complete image/PDF, which may contain identity.
ai.pii.standard: Text pseudonymized and restored with core/pii.py; reasonable effort.
ai.pii.institutional: Institutional, public or technical content, not patient data. Sent without the identity filter to keep contacts and examples.
ai.pii.mcp: The token-authorized connection hands tool data to the external client, including identity through whoami. pii.py is not applied to that response to the client. The product's internal AI readers keep the documented filter and exceptions.
ai.pii.voice: Transcription exception: the complete audio goes to the Fal provider/CDN; voice cannot be redacted before it is recognized. The chat text that follows does use pii.py.
ai.risk.rationale_clinical: Clinical or identity content: high until the hospital's assessment.
ai.risk.rationale_institutional: Institutional or technical content; no individual decisions.
ai.retention.unverified: Retention and final provider not verified; confirm per installation.
ai.state.tools_enabled: tools enabled; external AI not verified
ai.retention.free: Free model: retention, training use and final provider not verified. It may receive complete images with identity; verify the policy before enabling. Models: {models}
ai.oversight.referral: The patient verifies the reading; admissions approve, reject or refer in Requests. The AI does not decide.
ai.oversight.interview: The patient provides the answers; the doctor reviews the transcript in Consultation; it does not confirm appointments or recommend treatment.
ai.oversight.triage: The doctor reviews in Consultation before confirming; deterministic floor for urgent signals; no appointment changes.
ai.oversight.health_profile: Separate proposal per interview, visible in Consultation. Only Apply proposal and the doctor's explicit confirmation save the reviewed profile; the next interview uses only the confirmed one.
ai.oversight.consult_documents: Documents are generated only when the doctor or admin presses Confirm; human review before signing or use. Nothing is written to HSI.
ai.oversight.chart_summary: The professional cross-checks the sources in Summary/Consultation; it stores a derived cache, never a clinical note or an appointment decision.
ai.oversight.lab_reading: The patient consults the professional; sensitive results are referred to the doctor. Derived cache only, no diagnosis or clinical write.
ai.oversight.lab_upload: The patient uploads the file; the doctor verifies its origin. Marked as patient-provided, unverified.
ai.oversight.booking_chat: The patient confirms the exact service, patient and time before the request is created. Deterministic service rules may confirm it automatically; the AI never approves, rejects or cancels pending requests.
ai.oversight.chat_memory: Conversation memory, not a clinical record. The patient corrects it and the operator reviews it; it does not change appointments.
ai.oversight.mcp_assistant: The account authorizes the connection; the patient confirms the exact time through the tool's link. The external AI never supplies human authorization through an argument. Cancel only offers a human link.
ai.oversight.dni_reading: The user reviews and submits the form; OCR does not authenticate or store the photo.
ai.oversight.translation: The admin corrects the translations; the original serves if translation fails. It does not decide anything about patients.
ai.oversight.prompt_translation: The admin saves or restores instructions and reviews the differences; no model instructions are published without their action.
ai.oversight.knowledge_properties: The admin requests a proposal, edits and saves the article; a proposal does not publish by itself.
ai.oversight.health_probe: The admin runs Test; the probe does not process patients or change decisions.
ai.oversight.voice_transcription: The patient dictates and sends; they can review the text. Sending during recording asks to send after transcription. It does not confirm appointments or write a clinical note.
ai.oversight.case_chat: The desk reads the summary and, when needed, the whole conversation (recorded in the access log) and decides whether to give an extra slot. A deterministic floor points to the ER or 107 on urgent signs; the AI neither grants nor refuses appointments.
ai.prompt.orden_analisis.title: Reading the medical referral
ai.prompt.orden_analisis.does: Reads the photo of the referral and extracts the data the operator later sees in the queue: patient, ID number, specialty, requested studies, doctor, license number and date. It also decides whether the document really is a referral and whether it can be read.
ai.prompt.orden_analisis.where: When someone uploads their referral from the web, the chat or WhatsApp.
ai.prompt.orden_analisis.var.hoy: Today's date, in DD/MM/YYYY format. The AI judges against it whether the handwritten year it read is plausible.
ai.prompt.orden_analisis.var.jurisdiccio: Province and country of this installation, e.g. «Buenos Aires, Argentina». The AI compares the referral's origin against it to detect one issued in another jurisdiction.
ai.prompt.orden_estudios.title: Which studies the document requests
ai.prompt.orden_estudios.does: A cheaper reading with no verdict: it only extracts the list of requested studies, so the person can be told how to prepare (fasting, what to bring).
ai.prompt.orden_estudios.where: «Upload your referral», when only the preparation is needed.
ai.prompt.chat_sistema.title: How the appointment assistant answers
ai.prompt.chat_sistema.does: The tone and rules of the assistant that answers on chat and WhatsApp: speak briefly and plainly, never invent a time slot, confirm the specific appointment before requesting it, and how to offer tappable options.
ai.prompt.chat_anonimo.title: Assistant with someone who is not signed in
ai.prompt.chat_anonimo.does: Added to the above when the person writing has not signed in yet: it can search and show time slots, but not book appointments or read a referral.
ai.prompt.chat_anonimo.where: Site chat, visitor without an account.
ai.prompt.entrevista_preguntas.title: Pre-consult interview questions
ai.prompt.entrevista_preguntas.does: The tone and what to ask in the AI chat the patient has before the consultation: how to open, how to dig deeper depending on the answers, and what never to say (never diagnoses, never asserts severity or how long the wait will be).
ai.prompt.entrevista_preguntas.where: Pre-consult interview, after booking or on scanning the QR at the door.
ai.prompt.entrevista_preguntas.var.conte: Paragraph built in code with where and when the patient is speaking and how to close in an emergency — different depending on how they entered the interview: from home after booking (go to the emergency department of {hospital} or call the emergency number) or standing at the consulting-room door after scanning the sign (tell the staff at the desk or knock on the door — never send them to the emergency department or tell them to call an ambulance while already inside the hospital). It also adjusts how many questions make sense: up to 8 unhurried from home, at most 4 or 5 at the door, because the doctor is about to call them in.
ai.prompt.caso_preguntas.title: «Tell us your case» questions
ai.prompt.caso_preguntas.does: What the chat asks when there is no free slot and the patient leaves their case: up to three short questions (since when, whether they have results to show, how soon they need to be seen) so the desk can decide the urgency. It never diagnoses or promises an appointment.
ai.prompt.caso_preguntas.where: The «Tell us your case» step of a request with no time slots.
ai.prompt.caso_preguntas.var.max_pregunt: How many questions it may ask after the first answer (1 to 3). The chat stops by itself once there.
ai.prompt.caso_resumen.title: «Tell us your case» summary
ai.prompt.caso_resumen.does: Summarises for the desk the chat of a patient with no slot: what they want, the urgency (high, medium or low) and why, and the key facts. It is the first thing the desk sees in the request; the full chat is one click away.
ai.prompt.caso_resumen.where: When the «Tell us your case» chat ends.
ai.prompt.entrevista_orden.title: Wording of the study order
ai.prompt.entrevista_orden.does: Optional extra instructions for the AI pass that writes the printed study order when the doctor confirms the consultation. Unedited, the order is assembled as is without going through the AI (saves the cost on every confirmation). The doctor can add their own formatting or wording rules here.
ai.prompt.entrevista_orden.where: On confirming the consultation of the pre-consult interview.
ai.prompt.entrevista_receta.title: Wording of the prescription
ai.prompt.entrevista_receta.does: Optional extra instructions for the AI pass that writes the printed prescription when the doctor confirms the consultation. Unedited, the prescription is assembled as is without going through the AI. Examples of what can be asked here: «use the active substance instead of the brand name», «leave 3 cm free at the top» (the blank space of the letterhead).
ai.prompt.entrevista_receta.where: On confirming the consultation of the pre-consult interview.
ai.prompt.resumen_paciente.title: Patient summary
ai.prompt.resumen_paciente.does: Builds the pre-visit summary the doctor sees on opening the record: prioritized pending items, questions to ask in the consulting room, medication to verify, history and which laboratory trends to look at. It gathers what this system knows about the patient (appointments, pre-consult interview, digitized clinical record) and filters it by the doctor's specialty.
ai.prompt.resumen_paciente.where: Prepared overnight for the next day's confirmed appointments and when the record is opened.
ai.prompt.resumen_paciente.var.hoy: Today's date (DD/MM/YYYY), so the AI can tell recent data from old data.
ai.prompt.resumen_paciente.var.especiali: The specialty of the doctor who will see the patient — the summary's relevance filter.
ai.prompt.laboratorio_paciente.title: Patient laboratory reading
ai.prompt.laboratorio_paciente.does: For each digitized laboratory report: classifies the type of study, writes a cautious one-line reading (never a diagnosis, never alarming), decides whether the report is sensitive by the «Laboratory sensitivity criterion», which is appended to the end of these instructions, and extracts every determination it can read.
ai.prompt.laboratorio_paciente.where: «Laboratory results» tab of the patient's account, up to 10 reports at a time. It only runs for a new report or when these instructions or the sensitivity criterion change.
ai.prompt.laboratorio_paciente.var.catal: The closed catalogue of chartable determinations (key, name, unit and reference range of each), built in code. The AI may only use a key from here, and only when the report's unit matches exactly — it never converts units or invents a new key.
ai.prompt.laboratorio_sensible.title: Laboratory sensitivity criterion
ai.prompt.laboratorio_sensible.does: Defines which laboratory results are too delicate to show on the web on their own (oncology, biopsies and pathology, HIV and STI serology, pregnancy, genetic, toxicology): those reports are shown to the patient only as «your doctor has your results», with no values or summary. It is appended to the end of «Patient laboratory reading». In addition, a fixed list of words marks the clearest cases as sensitive even if this criterion does not cover them.
ai.prompt.laboratorio_sensible.where: «Laboratory results» tab of the patient's account, together with «Patient laboratory reading».
